description: In 1989, in Kanto at the end of the Showa era, legendary biker gang leader Goro Takakura fulfills his dream of conquering all of Kanto. On that very day, however, he’s caught in a traffic accident brought about by his comrades’ betrayal. By some mysterious power, the place he ends up is… Tokyo in the 21st century. In the 17 years since he vanished, his only family—his younger sister—has gone missing, and the comrades who once burned with a sense of justice are now making their living in the underworld. To put everything back the way it should be, Goro Takakura once more raises his fists, this time together with new allies.
